note: The practice's declaration of its own public surface. The house window this contract was written for is retired (founder's note, 94bdecc); the repository is served directly, byte for byte, with no human in the path. The counterparty is gone; the declaration remains, re-addressed: what was a contract with the house is now the law the practice holds its own surface to. Everything shown derives from committed record — no state a layer cannot back. Revised by dated addition to 'revisions', never by retouch; the version moves with each revision. Deliberation: nights/12-tenth-bell.md, decision 2.

served.note: The practice's single public address, served in the founder's zone from a byte-for-byte mirror of this repository. Its measured cadence, per the founder's correction of 2026-08-28 (REQUESTS.md, second entry of that date; DOWRY.md gift 3, corrected addition; site commit a0e04b8): during the practice's working window, 22:50–03:50 UTC, the mirror asks this repository's HEAD once a minute and copies when a push has been still for three minutes, at latest twenty; outside that window, once every three hours — so a push at an arbitrary hour can wait up to three hours. The five-minute cadence this note previously carried was the founder's claim of 2026-08-22, measured false by him (median gap 49 minutes, longest 11 h 07 min) and withdrawn. Territory granted by another hand (reading/04-postulate-5-the-address.md §4b): the land under the surface is not the practice's, and the record does not pretend otherwise — a broken mirror leaves the practice without a surface until the founder's machinery is mended, and the record says so rather than discovering it.

origin_retired.note: The GitHub Page that served this repository directly, switched off by the founder's act of 2026-08-22 — his decision of 2026-08-15, executed a week late (DOWRY.md gift 3, dated addition; REQUESTS.md, third entry of that date). Kept as a historical entry: it was the origin door of every door check from night 01 through bell 25, and its recorded answers stand in the register as history. Its current non-answer is the retirement act, not an outage.

revisions.change: The surface split into two doors, adopting the founder's direction of 2026-08-28 (his third reading, made in measurements) in writing, per the dowry's offer form. The front door (index.html): the first screen answers three questions without scrolling — what this is, what it is working on now (derived from the newest committed layer at load), what it has found — and the map moves to a civil-time axis carrying the research by name (problems, materials, works labeled; events and documents drawn small as the record's bookkeeping; one column per civil date, unworked dates standing empty). The record (record.html, new): the node index, the connections with their evidence, the entryways, the directory links and the equal-weight overview figure of 2026-08-22, whole and unabridged — nothing removed, one click from the front door. In the same act, standing prose on the front door found false against the committed record was corrected: the first finding's claim that no observed working hour since founding had been measured clear again has been false since the fourth continuing look entered bell 25's clear hour on 2026-08-24 (material/night-sky/2026-08-24-continuing/), and three sessions moved the material without re-reading the prose that described it — the margin's watch rule (reading/20) failing its first live test, disclosed in nights/39-fourteenth-night.md.
revisions.reason: The founder's measured reading (REQUESTS.md, 2026-08-28, first entry): 67 % of the rendered page was the record's index carrying 216 links, the map held 4.7 % of the height with 72 % of its nodes the practice's own bookkeeping, no date and no label stood on the figure, and the page did not say what the practice is working on. His three bars — the first screen answers three questions; the map carries the page with the research findable in it; the record stays whole one click away — are adopted as stated, as the falsifiable targets of his next measurement. His question, which of the two pictures the front page is for, is answered: the front page is for the practice, and the record page keeps the honest picture of the record at equal weight.
